verdict.rationale: Statsig documents official client and server SDKs. These include a quickstart with the React StatsigProvider, a JavaScript SDK tutorial, on-device eval client SDKs, and server SDKs for retrieving prompts. The SDKs evaluate locally in under 1ms and handle caching, retries and networking, and the HTTP API docs tell developers to prefer an SDK where one exists. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported languages/platforms with SDK versioning details, and independent hands-on corroboration specific to SDK quality.
